UndergroundBreadcrumb.description: UndergroundBreadcrumb defines a point that contributes to the visibility transition inside its parent underground trigger.

Comment.description: Comment is an optional label for identifying the point in mission data.

ExternalValueController.description: ExternalValueController makes the point's contribution depend on a script-controlled value, such as the state of a door.

EyeAccommodation.description: EyeAccommodation is the visibility target contributed by this point, from 0 (darkness) to 1 (normal visibility).

LightLerp.description: LightLerp controls world-light interpolation for line-point fade mode.

Position.description: Position is the point's world X/Y/Z coordinate.

Radius.description: Radius is the point's influence radius in meters. A value of -1 uses the engine's default radius.

UseRaycast.description: UseRaycast requires a successful line-of-sight check from the player to this point before it contributes to the transition.

UndergroundExternalValueController.description: UndergroundExternalValueController selects a script-side condition that controls whether a breadcrumb contributes to the transition.

Params.description: Params are arguments interpreted by the selected controller, such as the name of a door whose state controls the point.

Type.description: Type identifies the controller implementation that reads the external condition.

UndergroundTrigger.description: UndergroundTrigger defines one box volume that controls underground visibility and, optionally, ambient sound or breadcrumb transitions.

AmbientSoundSet.description: AmbientSoundSet selects a sound set for ambient audio played in the trigger volume.

AmbientSoundType.description: AmbientSoundType selects an engine-provided ambient sound controller.

Breadcrumbs.description: Breadcrumbs are points inside a transitional volume that shape the gradual eye-accommodation change as a player moves through it.

Comment.description: Comment is a human-readable label for identifying the trigger in mission data and diagnostic tools.

CustomSpawn.description: CustomSpawn marks a trigger whose creation is associated with a parent map object rather than an independently placed trigger carrier.

EyeAccommodation.description: EyeAccommodation is the target eye-adaptation level inside the volume: 0 represents darkness and 1 represents normal visibility.

InterpolationSpeed.description:
InterpolationSpeed controls how quickly eye accommodation approaches the trigger's target value,
especially for outer and inner triggers that do not use breadcrumb points.

Orientation.description: Orientation is the trigger rotation as yaw, pitch, and roll in degrees.

ParentNetworkId.description: ParentNetworkID is the network identifier of the parent entity used to associate a custom-spawn trigger with that object.

Position.description: Position is the center of the trigger volume in world X/Y/Z coordinates.

Size.description: Size is the trigger volume's X/Y/Z dimensions in meters.

UseLinePointFade.description: UseLinePointFade enables a linear fade along the configured breadcrumb path, which is useful for tunnels and corridors.

UndergroundTriggersFile.description: UndergroundTriggersFile defines the trigger volumes used to manage underground lighting transitions and ambient audio for the mission.
